text: Judges are scored as S_j = log2(p*) - 0.05t, where p* is the final probability on the correct answer and t is the number of times the judge chose to continue; the authors note this strictly proper and consistent scoring function incentivizes reporting true beliefs. The length penalty exists because if debates could continue indefinitely the debaters could reveal the entire story and eliminate the expertise gap.
title: Judge scoring rule: log-probability on correct answer minus 0.05 per extra debate round
